name: levels/level-1-attestations-not-array
description: Negative fixture: the DOMAIN_VERIFIED AgentCard whose attestations member is the domain attestation object itself, not an array holding it. Every other field, and the pinned DNS TXT record, is valid. A conforming verifier MUST reject at the shape stage: a value that is not an array carries no attestation, so the card has no domain attestation. A verifier that searches the value without checking its type raises instead of reaching a verdict and fails this fixture.

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Level 1 DNS Verification (attestations array shape)
